title: Field Trip Waiver Sign-In Log
subtitle: Capture trip destination, transport, activity condition, and supervision; confirm guardian choice and return.
description: Field Trip Waiver records trip destination, transport, activity condition, supervision, guardian choice, and return. Field Trip Waiver evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this field trip waiver attendance and custody reconciliation when staff must document trip destination and transport. Reconcile activity condition, supervision, guardian choice, and return before the field trip waiver handoff. Use the itinerary, transportation plan, disclosed activity conditions, supervision roster, accessible alternative, participant questions, guardian choice, and return headcount. This acknowledgment concerns an excursion with bus or walking travel, off-site terrain, destination activities, chaperone supervision, group movement, and school return. Ask the assigned field trip waiver reviewer to confirm trip destination against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Field Trip Waiver details
sections.guidance: Disclose destination, transport conditions, walking or activity demands, supervision, available alternative, guardian choice, emergency route, and return. Record the field trip waiver decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

sections.title: Field Trip Waiver participant identity and waiver-status review
sections.guidance: Match each participant to the named activity, current waiver version, signer or guardian status, and participation limit.

blocks.label: Field Trip Waiver roster boundary
blocks.guidance: Check-in does not replace a completed waiver choice. Route any missing signer, outdated version, participation limit, or unanswered question before participation.

sections.title: Field Trip Waiver decision and participant reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile participant count, waiver status, and every open question before close.
